name: disable-places-rls
sql: alter table public.places disable row level security

name: places-policy-using-true
sql: do $policy$ declare p record; begin for p in select policyname from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename='places' and cmd in ('SELECT','ALL') loop execute format('drop policy %I on public.places',p.policyname); end loop; end $policy$; create policy taw29_mutation_select on public.places for select to authenticated using (true)

name: disable-routes-rls
sql: alter table public.routes disable row level security

name: routes-policy-using-true
sql: do $policy$ declare p record; begin for p in select policyname from pg_policies where schemaname='public' and tablename='routes' and cmd in ('SELECT','ALL') loop execute format('drop policy %I on public.routes',p.policyname); end loop; end $policy$; create policy taw29_mutation_select on public.routes for select to authenticated using (true)

name: publish-not-definer
sql: do $mutation$ declare target regprocedure; begin select p.oid::regprocedure into strict target from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='publish_ride'; execute format('alter function %s security invoker',target); end $mutation$

name: publish-search-path-public
sql: do $mutation$ declare target regprocedure; begin select p.oid::regprocedure into strict target from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid=p.pronamespace where n.nspname='public' and p.proname='publish_ride'; execute format('alter function %s set search_path=public',target); end $mutation$

name: grant-car-capacity-update
sql: grant update(passenger_seats) on public.car_types to authenticated

name: rides-select-without-rls
sql: alter table public.rides disable row level security; grant select on public.rides to authenticated
